description: Counterfactual vendor-swap risk comparison. Runs the same assessment used by /ot/vendor-risk on each vendor and returns the risk-tier delta plus per-vendor summaries, for pre-purchase or migration decisions. Price: $0.20 USDC per call via x402 on Base mainnet. An unpaid call returns an x402 PaymentRequired challenge; retry the identical call with the signed payload in _meta["x402/payment"].

product_current.description: Optional current product line e.g. SIMATIC

product_proposed.description: Optional proposed product line e.g. Modicon

vendor_current.description: Current OT/ICS vendor name e.g. Siemens

vendor_proposed.description: Proposed replacement vendor name e.g. Schneider Electric

name: getVendorRiskDelta
title: Vendor-Swap Risk Comparison
